priorityList: Summon your pet before starting combat.
Use Algethar Puzzle Box before the pull or when Bestial Wrath's cooldown is less than 2 seconds.
Use offensive racials (such as Berserking, Blood Fury, or Fireblood) and Combat Potions while Bestial Wrath is active.
Activate offensive trinkets (e.g., Light Company Guidon, Void Execution Mandate) when Bestial Wrath is active.
Cast Barbed Shot if Bestial Wrath's cooldown is less than one global cooldown to ensure you maximize cooldown reduction.
Cast Bestial Wrath as soon as it becomes available.
Cast Kill Command as your primary priority to trigger Pack Leader abilities and maintain pet damage.
Cast Cobra Shot if Wild Thrash is on cooldown, the Hogstrider buff is active, and there are fewer than 4 enemies.
Cast Barbed Shot to maintain pet Frenzy stacks or to prevent charges from capping.
Cast Cobra Shot as a filler whenever Wild Thrash is on cooldown.
